blurb: Guests meet in Yountville for check-in with pastries and hot beverages, then are transported to the launch site. Flights last about 45 minutes to 1 hour, flying over vineyards and mountains. After landing, guests are shuttled back to Yountville and can enjoy wine tastings reserved through their concierge service.
extraNote: Cancel or reschedule minimum 48 hours prior to avoid full charge · Flight may be cancelled due to weather; no charge if cancelled by operator · All guests must sign a liability waiver before participating · Zero tolerance for chargeback fraud; legal action may be taken · Meet in Yountville at 6525 Washington St. · Flights offered throughout the year
